blocks.text: Architecture & Architectural Design | DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) provides architectural design, reconstruction, interior architecture, and 3D visualization services for private houses, residential properties, and commercial spaces.
We develop individual architectural solutions based on the characteristics of each property, its functional purpose, aesthetics, and the client’s requirements.
Architectural Design We develop individual architectural concepts and projects for private houses, residential properties, and commercial buildings.
Our work may include the overall architectural concept, spatial and volumetric solutions, facade design, proportions, materials, and the exterior appearance of the building.
Facade Design & Architectural Solutions We create facade designs and architectural solutions for both new and existing buildings.
Finishing materials, color combinations, architectural details, proportions, and exterior lighting are carefully considered to create a cohesive and contemporary appearance.
Facade design can be developed for new construction as well as for the reconstruction or modernization of an existing property.
Building Reconstruction & Adaptation We develop architectural solutions for the reconstruction of existing buildings, updating their appearance and adapting spaces to new functional requirements.
For historic or architecturally significant buildings, design solutions are developed with consideration for the specific characteristics of the property and applicable preservation requirements.
Site Planning & Landscape Solutions The architecture of a building can be complemented by a coordinated concept for the surrounding outdoor space.

We can develop solutions for pathways, relaxation areas, exterior lighting, landscaping, trees, shrubs, lawns, and other site elements so that the building and its surroundings form a unified architectural composition.

Energy-Efficient Architectural Solutions Where appropriate, the design can incorporate modern energy-efficient solutions, efficient use of materials, and technologies aimed at improving building performance and reducing future operating costs.
Interior Architecture We design interior spaces with consideration for the architecture of the building, floor plan, functional zoning, and the way each space will be used.

Architecture and interior design are approached as a unified system. This makes it possible to coordinate the exterior appearance of the building with its internal spaces, layouts, functionality, and overall interior concept.
3D Modeling & Architectural Visualization We create detailed, photorealistic 3D visualizations of facades, exteriors, interiors, and surrounding outdoor areas.

Architectural 3D visualization makes it possible to evaluate the building’s proportions, facade materials, color combinations, architectural details, lighting, and relationship with the surrounding environment before implementation begins.
3D visualizations can also be used to present and review the proposed architectural concept.

Technical Documentation Depending on the scope of the project, we prepare the necessary working drawings, plans, specifications, and other technical documentation required for the further implementation of the developed solutions.
The exact documentation package is determined individually according to the type of property, project requirements, and agreed scope of architectural work.
Project Support DUMSKAYA DESIGN can support the project at different stages of implementation and coordinate with contractors, manufacturers, and other specialists involved in the project.
Where necessary, architectural solutions can be adapted according to the technical characteristics of the specific property and applicable building requirements.

Individual Architectural Solutions Every project is approached individually. We can develop a completely new architectural concept or adapt an existing solution to a specific site, building, layout, and client requirements.
The scope of work can include building architecture, facade design, interior architecture, surrounding site and landscape solutions, and photorealistic 3D visualization.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — architectural design, facade design, interior architecture, and 3D visualization for private, residential, and commercial properties.
